title: Padding canonical seam configurations
statement: Let $k,K$ be natural numbers with $0<k$, let $S$ be a state type, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $q\in S$ and $w,o$ be Boolean words. Padding the configuration on $x$ formed from state $q$ and the tape-word assignment that places $w$ on tape $0$ and leaves the other tapes empty, with output set to $o$, to $K$ work tapes gives the configuration on $x$ formed from the same state and word assignment over $K$ tapes, with output $o$.
replaced:
For a positive source tape count, padding the canonical configuration built from
a state word (data word on tape zero, other tapes blank) yields the canonical
configuration over the larger tape count built from the same state word, with
the same output.
